title: Sustaining vacancy catalysis via conformal graphene overlays boosts practical Li–S batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01134E, Paper
Jiaxi Gu, Zixiong Shi, Yongbiao Mu, Yuzhu Wu, Meng Tian, Ziang Chen, Kaihui Chen, Huicun Gu, Miaoyu Lu, Lin Zeng, Yuqing Song, Qiang Zhang, Jingyu Sun
A vacancy catalysis sustainer using directly grown graphene mitigates the detrimental coverage on active sites and promotes the preferential decomposition of anions, thereby achieving long-life Li–S batteries.
